theater: 色薩利、拉米亞與希臘中部

battle.name: 拉米亞戰爭
battle.theater: 色薩利、拉米亞與希臘中部
battle.brief: 公元前323年亞歷山大大帝在巴比倫病逝，雅典、埃托利亞與色薩利等城邦組成「希臘同盟」，起兵反抗馬其頓歐洲統帥安提帕特，聯軍一度將他圍困於拉米亞，最終在前322年8月的克拉諾斯戰敗。卡面埃及月牙劍未隨軍而至，但外彎單刃的近身格殺傳統仍由色雷斯式彎刀與半月形輕盾延續。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的一方是「希臘同盟」：雅典及其海軍居中樞，埃托利亞聯盟、色薩利聯盟與福基斯為核心，北面有奧伊塔亞、阿開亞弗提奧提斯、馬利斯（拉米亞除外）、多里斯、洛克利斯、阿伊尼斯、多洛皮亞與阿塔馬尼亞，島嶼方面有琉卡斯，部分摩羅索斯人以及伊利里亞與色雷斯部落亦加入；伯羅奔尼撒方面有阿爾戈斯、西基翁、埃庇達魯斯、特羅埃曾、弗利翁斯、埃利斯與墨塞尼亞。斯巴達因阿吉斯三世一戰元氣重傷而拒絕加入。另一方是馬其頓歐洲總督安提帕特率領的馬其頓軍與亞洲歸來的援軍，盟邦包括玻俄提亞同盟、厄維亞島聯盟與阿卡納尼亞同盟。安提帕特在愛琴海可用的兵力，是亞歷山大生前在黎凡特下令建造的一千艘戰艦中的一部分，另有被解職的財務官哈帕魯斯帶回的大筆軍資。聯盟的組成幾乎完全由「放逐令」決定：受令威脅的城邦有共同的切身利害，而亞歷山大本人已死、繼承尚未確定，這正是同盟得以在數月之內迅速成形的原因。
countriesEn: One side was the Hellenic League, with Athens and its navy at the centre and the Aetolian League, the Thessalian League and Phocis as core members, joined in the north by Oetaea, Achaea Phthiotis, the Malians (except Lamia), Doris, Locris, Ainis, Dolopia and Athamania, by the island of Leukas in the Ionian Sea, and by some Molossians in Epirus together with Illyrian and Thracian tribes; on the Peloponnese side of the coalition stood Argos, Sicyon, the Acte peninsula with Epidaurus and Troezen, Phlius, Elis and Messenia. Sparta refused to join, exhausted as it was by its defeat under Agis III. The other side was the Macedonian army of Antipater, regent of Europe, reinforced from Asia, supported by the Boeotian League, the Euboean League and the Acarnanian League. What Antipater could rely on in the Aegean was part of the thousand warships Alexander had ordered built in the Levant, together with the sums of money the dismissed royal treasurer Harpalus had brought back. Membership of the coalition was almost entirely dictated by the Exiles' Decree: the cities it threatened shared an immediate interest, and with Alexander dead and no succession settled, a common cause could be organised within a few months.
people: 亞歷山大大帝於公元前323年6月11日在巴比倫病逝，未及安排繼承，這一消息成為整場戰爭的引爆點。馬其頓方面由攝政安提帕特主持歐洲戰事，他以方陣兵與隨行艦隊南下，並在色薩利就地徵兵；亞洲歸來的克拉泰羅斯帶回老兵與波斯弓兵，里昂納托斯與白色的克利圖斯分別率援軍與龐大艦隊馳援。希臘同盟這邊最具決定性的人物是里奧斯提尼：他在斯巴達的泰納魯斯角集結約八千名散兵傭兵，率七千埃托利亞步兵與雅典派出的重裝兵、傭兵、騎兵合計約三萬人守住溫泉關，並把安提帕特圍在拉米亞；公元前323年冬他出擊陣亡，由安提菲洛斯接任統帥。色薩利騎兵統將梅農在梅利泰阿的騎兵戰中擊殺里昂納托斯，成為雙方陣營中最具影響力的單次交鋒。雅典方面，德摩斯提尼力主開戰，流亡後返國重振民氣，最終服毒自盡；希佩里得斯於克萊奧奈被殺；福基翁與德馬得斯則是始終反對開戰、戰後主持投降議和的人。史家狄奧多羅斯·西西里奧是本戰爭的主要古代來源，其記述又大量取自卡爾迪亞的希羅尼莫斯。
peopleEn: Alexander the Great died at Babylon on 11 June 323 BC without arranging a succession, and the news of that death triggered the whole war. On the Macedonian side the regent Antipater directed the European war with his phalanx and the fleet that sailed in company, and drew further troops from Thessaly on the spot; Craterus came back from Asia with veterans and Persian archers, while Leonnatus and Cleitus the White arrived with reinforcements and a large fleet. The decisive figure on the Hellenic side was Leosthenes, who gathered some eight thousand disbanded mercenaries at Taenarum in Spartan territory, led the seven thousand Aetolian infantry together with the hoplites, mercenaries and cavalry sent by Athens for a total of about thirty thousand men, held the pass of Thermopylae and shut Antipater up in Lamia; he was killed during a sortie in the winter of 323 BC and was succeeded by Antiphilos. Menon of Pharsalus, commander of the Thessalian cavalry, killed Leonnatus in the cavalry action at Melitaea, the single most consequential engagement between the two sides. On the Athenian side Demosthenes pressed for war and, returning from exile, revived morale before taking his own life; Hypereides was killed at Kleonai; Phocion and Demades had opposed the war from the beginning and led the surrender negotiations afterwards. Diodorus of Sicily is the principal ancient source for the war, and his narrative draws heavily on Hieronymus of Cardia.
kits: 卡面所示的埃及月牙劍是青銅時代的外彎單刃短劍，形制早於本戰爭一千八百餘年，戰場上並沒有它。希臘中部實際交戰的裝備屬於另一套體系：重裝步兵持蒙銅圓盾（aspis）、青銅頭盔、直刃銅劍（xiphos）與兩枝短矛；色薩利與馬其頓騎兵用雙刃劍配短標槍；埃托利亞與色雷斯傭兵偏好外彎單刃的彎刀（kopis）與擲槍，這種弧形刃與卡面月牙劍共享同一個東地中海近身格殺傳統，視覺上最接近的則是輕裝兵的半月形小盾（pelta）。投射兵器方面，克拉泰羅斯自奇里乞亞帶來一千名波斯弓兵與投石手，與拉米亞圍城中的各類攻城器械（撞槌、雲梯、投石機）一同投入。馬其頓方陣以多縱深密集排列、各持約兩米長的長矛（sarissa）作戰，但安提帕特在色薩利敗陣後只能退守拉米亞以待援軍。海軍方面，雅典擁有三百六十艘三列槳、五十艘四列槳與七艘五列槳戰艦，馬其頓則有護送亞歷山大財產的一百一十艘三列槳，以及克利圖斯率領的二百四十艘戰艦。
kitsEn: The khopesh shown on the card is an out-curved single-edged bronze short sword whose shape predates this war by more than eighteen centuries, and it was never present on the Greek battlefield. The equipment actually used in central Greece belonged to a different system: hoplites carried a bronze-faced round shield (aspis), a bronze helmet, a straight-edged sword (xiphos) and two short spears; Thessalian and Macedonian horsemen used double-edged swords with short javelins; Aetolian and Thracian mercenaries preferred the out-curved single-edged kopis and their throwing spears, a curved blade that shares the same eastern Mediterranean tradition of close combat as the khopesh, and the closest visual equivalent on the field was the crescent-shaped pelta of the peltasts. For missiles, Craterus brought a thousand Persian archers and slingers from Cilicia, and they were used together with the siege equipment of the winter siege of Lamia, including battering rams, ladders and stone-throwers. The Macedonian phalanx fought in deep, closely ranked files with sarissas a little over two metres long, but after his reverse in Thessaly Antipater could only hold Lamia and wait for reinforcements. At sea Athens had three hundred and sixty triremes, fifty quadriremes and seven quinqueremes, while Macedonia had the hundred and ten triremes that escorted Alexander's treasure and the two hundred and forty warships that Cleitus brought.
tactics: 作戰起於隘口控制。里奧斯提尼以約三萬人扼守溫泉關，安提帕特則企圖先在色薩利平原上以騎兵展開，結果色薩利騎兵倒戈，擊潰馬其頓騎兵，安提帕特被迫退回拉米亞——該城在溫泉關以北約十五公里，且是當地唯一仍效忠馬其頓的城市。退守拉米亞是一步以退為進的安排：既避免全軍被殲，又把圍城與攻城的成本交給希臘聯軍。圍城延續於公元前323年冬至前322年，安提帕特靠一百一十艘三列槳沿海岸輸送糧秣，希臘聯軍則以埃托利亞步兵與雅典海軍封鎖沿海，使城內糧食逐日緊張，馬其頓士兵開始逃亡；里奧斯提尼正是在一次出擊中被流石擊中陣亡，統帥之死直接導致希臘聯軍放棄圍城。海上的勝負同樣關鍵：白色的克利圖斯率二百四十艘戰艦，在厄基那德斯島群兩度擊敗雅典海軍統帥歐厄提翁，迫使埃托利亞聯盟放棄圍城回援本土；其後阿莫爾戈斯海戰中，雅典雖有四百一十艘以上戰艦卻只能配齊約兩百艘的船員，兵員不足下全軍潰敗。陸戰方面，里昂納托斯在梅利泰阿遭色薩利騎兵擊殺；克拉泰羅斯率馬其頓老兵與波斯弓兵趕到後，聯軍在克拉諾斯再無優勢。安提帕特以四萬步兵、五千騎兵對聯軍二萬五千重裝步卒與三千五百馬匹，騎兵牽制住色薩利騎兵，步兵主力同時壓向聯軍兩翼，最終以正面壓力迫使其退讓；戰後他逐一與各城談判，聯盟因此被拆散。
tacticsEn: The campaign began with the control of a pass. Leosthenes held the Thermopylae with about thirty thousand men, while Antipater meant to open the fighting on the Thessalian plain with his cavalry; the Thessalian horse changed sides, destroyed the Macedonian cavalry and forced Antipater back to Lamia, a city some fifteen kilometres north of the pass and the only place in the district still loyal to Macedonia. Falling back on Lamia was a deliberate arrangement: it avoided the destruction of the whole army and handed the Greeks the costs of the siege and the assault. The siege ran through the winter of 323/322 BC. Antipater's hundred and ten triremes carried grain along the coast, while the Aetolian infantry and the Athenian navy blockaded the shoreline and tightened the food situation inside the town until Macedonian soldiers began to desert; Leosthenes was struck down by a sling stone during one of the sorties, and his death directly caused the Greeks to lift the siege. The war at sea was equally decisive: Cleitus the White, with two hundred and forty warships, twice defeated the Athenian admiral Euetion off the Echinades, forcing the Aetolian League to abandon the siege and go home to defend its own territory; in the Battle of Amorgos that followed, Athens could man only about two hundred of its more than four hundred and ten warships and was routed. On land Leonnatus was killed by the Thessalian cavalry at Melitaea, and when Craterus arrived with Macedonian veterans and Persian archers the Greeks held no advantage at Crannon. Antipater brought forty thousand foot, five thousand cavalry and three thousand archers and slingers against twenty-five thousand hoplites and three thousand five hundred horses, using the cavalry to pin the Thessalian horse while the infantry pressed both flanks, and the result was enough to force the allies back. Afterwards he negotiated city by city, and the coalition came apart.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力與日期上。亞歷山大于公元前323年6月11日卒於巴比倫；戰爭實際爆發在同年9月初，盟約在9月中旬前後陸續訂立，雅典另撥五十塔連特銀給里奧斯提尼支付傭兵軍餉。聯軍方面，雅典派出五千重裝步兵、二千傭兵與五百騎兵，里奧斯提尼另率七千埃托利亞步兵，全軍約三萬人。安提帕特初戰投入一萬三千名方陣兵與六百騎兵，隨行一百一十艘三列槳戰艦，在色薩利又徵得約二千騎兵；方陣兵的數字有抄本疑問，波斯沃思認為應為三千名馬其頓人加一萬三千名傭兵。拉米亞距溫泉關約十五公里。里昂納托斯的援軍為二萬步兵與一千五百騎兵；克拉泰羅斯帶來一萬重裝步兵（其中六千為老兵）、一千五百騎兵，以及一千名波斯弓兵與投石手；兩軍合流後安提帕特指揮約四萬人、三千弓箭手與投石手及五千騎兵，聯軍則為二萬五千重裝步卒與三千五百馬匹。決定性的克拉諾斯會戰在公元前322年8月6日爆發（部分學者作8月5日），聯軍陣亡約五百人，其中雅典人二百，馬其頓軍陣亡一百三十。戰敗的直接代價，是雅典的公民資格財產門檻被提高到二千德拉克馬，享有政治權利的公民由約二萬一千人減至九千人；馬其頓駐軍則在公元前322年9月18日進駐穆尼奇亞要塞。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked cluster around strengths and dates. Alexander died at Babylon on 11 June 323 BC; the war actually broke out in early September of that year, the alliances being concluded one after another around mid-September, and Athens voted fifty talents of silver to Leosthenes to pay his mercenaries. On the Hellenic side Athens supplied five thousand hoplites, two thousand mercenaries and five hundred cavalry, Leosthenes commanded seven thousand Aetolian infantry, and the whole force came to about thirty thousand men. Antipater's first army contained thirteen thousand phalangites and six hundred horsemen, with a hundred and ten triremes sailing in company, and he raised about two thousand more cavalry in Thessaly; the figure for the phalangites is doubted on the grounds of a textual corruption, and Bosworth suggests three thousand Macedonians and thirteen thousand mercenaries instead. Lamia lies about fifteen kilometres north of the Thermopylae. Leonnatus brought twenty thousand foot and fifteen hundred cavalry; Craterus brought ten thousand hoplites, six thousand of them veterans, with fifteen hundred cavalry and a thousand Persian archers and slingers. Once the two were merged Antipater commanded about forty thousand men, three thousand archers and slingers and five thousand cavalry, against twenty-five thousand hoplites and three thousand five hundred horses. The decisive action at Crannon was fought on 6 August 322 BC, though some scholars give 5 August; about five hundred of the allies were killed, two hundred of them Athenians, against one hundred and thirty Macedonians. The direct price of defeat was a rise in the Athenian property qualification for citizenship to two thousand drachmas, cutting the number of citizens with political rights from about twenty-one thousand to nine thousand, and a Macedonian garrison took up residence in the fortress of Munychia on 18 September 322 BC.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因是亞歷山大之死與其繼承安排的中斷。這位征服者生前把希臘城市拉進科林斯同盟，卻始終未能在其控制的兩大洲之間建立穩妥的權力交接程序；他死後，攝政安提帕特主張維持馬其頓的歐洲霸權，而亞歷山大的血緣繼承者（半弟腓力三世與幼子亞歷山大四世）身邊另聚了一批主張分權的將領，任何一方都無法確保在帝國瓜分中佔上風。深層原因是亞歷山大留下的放逐令：公元前324年8月4日，他在奧林匹克運動會上當眾宣讀該令，要求各城歸還被放逐者，會場聚集約兩萬名放逐者。雅典因此被迫交出薩摩斯的殖民據點與居民，埃托利亞聯盟被迫放棄前330年攻下的奧伊尼亞戴，兩者的積怨同時被點燃。另一項客觀條件是兵源：亞歷山大生前的龐大傭兵軍在未獲安置的情況下大量返回希臘，其中一批被傭兵首領里奧斯提尼用船運回本土，構成聯軍最完整的骨幹；而安提帕特若要逐城平叛，同樣必須在分散各處的城邦之間長距離調兵，節制艱難。希臘同盟因此在九月的尼米亞運動會前後迅速成形，並仿照波斯大戰時期的海上同盟體例，選在扼守通道的拉米亞發動進攻。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was the death of Alexander and the interruption of his arrangements for succession. The conqueror had drawn the Greek cities into the League of Corinth, yet had never established a workable handover of power between the two continents he controlled; after his death the regent Antipater defended Macedonian hegemony in Europe, while a separate group of officers gathered around Alexander's blood heirs, his half-brother Philip III and the boy Alexander IV, pressed for a division of the empire, and neither side could be sure of the upper hand in the partition to come. The deeper cause lay in the Exiles' Decree: on 4 August 324 BC Alexander had it read aloud at the Olympic Games before a crowd of some twenty thousand exiles. Athens was made to give up its cleruchy and its settlers on Samos, and the Aetolian League was made to surrender Oeniadae, which it had taken around 330 BC, so that the grievances of both were lit at the same moment. A further condition was the supply of men: the vast mercenary armies of Alexander, never properly settled, came back to Greece in large numbers, and a batch of them was carried back to the mainland by the mercenary leader Leosthenes, providing the Hellenic League with its most coherent military core; for Antipater, who would have to fight city after city among scattered leagues, the same dispersion meant long lines of communication and slow redeployment. The coalition accordingly hardened quickly around the Nemean Games of September, copied the maritime league of the Persian War in form, and opened the war with an attack on Lamia, the city that guarded the pass.
impact: 拉米亞戰爭是雅典作為獨立強國的最後一場大戰。此後雅典交出海軍、在穆尼奇亞接受馬其頓駐軍、放棄阿提卡以外的屬地與奧羅波斯的阿姆菲阿瑞翁神廟，政體由民主改為財產門檻更高的寡頭統治，公民總數大幅縮減，建築、大理石與金屬作坊亦隨之停擺。德摩斯提尼之死被後世視為自由希臘消亡的標誌，希臘人在十九世紀的民族主義敘事中把克拉諾斯視為自主城邦世界終結的分水嶺。反過來說，埃托利亞聯盟幾乎全身而退，既保住了地盤又保住了自己的聯盟機構，成為希蘭化時代最重要的國家之一；雅典承擔了絕大部分戰鬥，卻什麼也沒有得到，這一結局也成為聯盟戰爭中主力承擔者吃虧的典型案例。更宏觀的一點是：安提帕特在拉米亞獲勝後即被召回亞洲，繼業者之間的分裂戰爭全面展開，東地中海的秩序由城邦聯盟轉入幾個大國的時代；個人重裝步兵的裝備體系（青銅頭盔、蒙銅圓盾、短柄直刃銅劍）也逐漸被方陣長矛與大型攻城機械取代。卡面所代表的埃及月牙劍所屬的那個古老刀劍傳統，隨着希臘化時期的武器交流進入作坊，卻已不再是戰場的主流。
impactEn: The Lamian War was the last great war Athens fought as an independent power. Afterwards it gave up its navy, accepted a Macedonian garrison at Munychia, surrendered its possessions outside Attica together with the sanctuary of the Amphiareion at Oropos, and saw its constitution rewritten as an oligarchy with a higher property qualification, with the citizen body shrinking sharply and the building trades, the marble workshops and the metal workshops of the city falling silent. The death of Demosthenes came to stand for the extinction of a free Greece, and in nineteenth-century national historiography Crannon became the watershed at which the world of the autonomous city-states ended. In the other direction, the Aetolian League came through almost untouched: it kept both its territory and its own federal organisation, and became one of the most important states of the Hellenistic age. Athens had carried most of the fighting and received none of the reward, which made the war a standing example of what happens when the main effort of a coalition is borne by one member. On the larger stage, Antipater was recalled to Asia as soon as Lamia was won, the wars of the successors opened in full, and the order of the eastern Mediterranean passed from a league of city-states to a handful of successor kingdoms; at the same time the equipment of the individual hoplite, with bronze helmet, bronze-faced round shield and short straight-edged sword, was gradually displaced by the sarissa phalanx and large siege machinery. The ancient sword tradition to which the Egyptian khopesh on the card belongs did travel into the workshops of the Hellenistic age, but it was no longer the mainstream of the battlefield.

resultEn: On the question of Crannon the Macedonians had won outright. The morale of the Hellenic League had been worn down by the reverse at Melitaea and by the naval defeats off the Echinades, and Antipater gave the allies no time to recover: he negotiated city by city, offering recognition of existing arrangements in exchange for separate surrenders, so that members competed with one another for the best terms and the coalition fell apart within months. In September 322 BC the Athenian envoys Demades, Phocion and Xenocrates of Chalcedon went to Antipater and accepted a garrison at Munychia, the surrender of the fleet and an oligarchic constitution; Athens then purged the war party, Hypereides was killed at Kleonai on 6 October, and Demosthenes took poison about a week later before reaching Athens. The Aetolian League refused to surrender, and Antipater's attempt to deal with it in the west was cut short when he was recalled to Asia, which left Aetolia the real winner of the war. Antipater handed the supervision of the Peloponnese to Deinarchus of Corinth, who held the post until Polyperchon had him seized and executed in 318 BC. Taken as a whole, the siege of Lamia was the one moment at which the Hellenic League came closest to threatening Macedonian rule in Europe; after Crannon no league of Greek city-states could stand against Macedonia again, and within a generation the Greek poleis became the subjects and rivals of the successor kings.
